status: One bounded synthetic loopback test. Deployment readiness remains unverified.
result: Four clients submitted 100 events at concurrency four. All were accepted and the synthetic dashboard returned 100. Request median was 5.55 ms and p95 was 36.04 ms.
limitations: In-memory H2 on one workstation, 316.59 events per second over a short run. This does not measure sustained load, durable storage or multiple instances. Docker and PostgreSQL remain unverified.
